title: GFD-OPD: Guidance-Folded On-Policy Distillation of Diffusion Models Across Scales
abstract: arXiv:2609.39692v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has demonstrated two important capabilities in language models: compressing large teachers into smaller students and merging expert models into a single model. Existing diffusion OPD, however, mostly focus on the latter, with teachers and students sharing the same backbone and scale. We investigate large-to-small diffusion opd from large teachers to a small student and find that the standard recipe fails. To find the underlying cause, we propose Fixed-State KL, an effective and fair way to measure the distribution gap between student and teacher during OPD training for diffusion models. We are the first to clarify why large-to-small OPD is challenging for diffusion models: a smaller student struggles to perfectly match the distribution of a larger teacher, while classifier-free guidance can accumulate and amplify the distributional discrepancies between the student's conditional and unconditional branches a

translated_title: GFD-OPD：跨尺度的引导折叠扩散模型在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.39692v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在语言模型中已展现出两项重要能力：将大型教师模型压缩为更小的学生模型，以及将多个专家模型合并为单一模型。然而，现有的扩散模型OPD大多集中于后者，即教师与学生共享相同的主干网络和规模。我们研究了从大型教师模型到小型学生模型的跨尺度扩散模型在线策略蒸馏，并发现标准方法会失效。为了探究其根本原因，我们提出了Fixed-State KL，这是一种在扩散模型OPD训练过程中有效且公平地衡量学生与教师之间分布差距的方法。我们首次阐明了为什么从大到小的OPD对扩散模型而言具有挑战性：较小的学生模型难以完美匹配较大教师模型的分布，而无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）会累积并放大学生模型条件分支与无条件分支之间的分布差异……
tldr: 该论文首次揭示了扩散模型从大到小跨尺度在线策略蒸馏失败的根源——小规模学生难以完美匹配大教师模型的分布，且无分类器引导会累积放大条件与无条件分支间的分布差异，并提出Fixed-State KL作为公平衡量师生分布差距的有效方法。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Fixed-State KL and is the first to clarify why large-to-small on-policy distillation is challenging for diffusion models: a smaller student struggles to match a larger teacher's distribution, while classifier-free guidance accumulates and amplifies the distributional discrepancies between the student's conditional and unconditional branches.
